purpose: Correct one source-schema interpretation error discovered by the outcome-blind V34 count audit. This is not a threshold, direction, universe or outcome rescue, and it does not alter any economic signal choice.

triggering_outcome_blind_incident.observed: All 8,197 in-scope distribution rows were rejected because the parent runner required a finite rights_subscription_ratio equal to zero; zero candidate and representation rows were produced.
triggering_outcome_blind_incident.scientific_effect: The parent V34 exact implementation remains permanently closed and its artifacts remain unchanged. The first V34R1 publication attempt failed closed before publication when the same optional-zero issue was detected in the CY-006 joined rights_ratio. A later publication attempt reached the non-filtering collision summary and failed closed because the active isolated runtime lacks SciPy; no artifact was published. All observations were outcome blind; V34R1 is a separately named semantic-correction experiment.

source_semantic_authority.distribution_contract: The distribution branch assigns rights_subscription_ratio=np.nan and rights_subscription_price=np.nan because rights terms are structurally inapplicable to a distribution row.
source_semantic_authority.rights_contract: Actual rights issues are normalized into the separate rights_issues.parquet asset with a positive rights_subscription_ratio when source terms are complete.
source_semantic_authority.composite_contract: The sealed normalizer's composite action logic maps a distribution structural N/A to economic zero only while separately summing actual rights rows.

cy006_optional_zero_authority.frozen_engineering_contract: Coalesce null optional rights_ratio to zero exactly as canonical finite_or_default semantics require; no lineage, feature, gate, population or interpretation change.

only_semantic_correction.parent_incorrect_test: distribution rights_subscription_ratio must be finite and equal to zero
only_semantic_correction.v34r1_test: Every distribution row entering the pure-cash test must have rights_subscription_ratio structurally missing exactly as required by the sealed distribution normalizer; then and only then it may be represented internally as economic zero for reuse of the parent eligibility logic.
only_semantic_correction.independent_rights_guard: No rights_issues row may exist for the same normalized market symbol and effective date. Rights-table duplicate, revision, identity, completeness and collision checks remain fail closed.
only_semantic_correction.cy006_guard: The joined CY-006 event-date optional rights_ratio may be null or finite zero under the already-frozen canonical optional-zero contract; only null is represented as economic zero. Any finite nonzero or nonfinite nonmissing value fails closed. The row must still exactly match the sole QD-010 action ID, cash amount and share_multiplier=1.
only_semantic_correction.unexpected_value_policy: Any finite distribution rights_subscription_ratio, schema drift or nonmissing unexpected value fails closed; it is not silently coerced.

unchanged_frozen_science.universe: Historical non-ST, valid and tradable Main Board and ChiNext identities under the exact parent V34 contract.
unchanged_frozen_science.cash_yield: cash_per_share_gross divided by raw event-date preclose
unchanged_frozen_science.cooldown: strictly more than 120 global sessions since the last retained event for the same symbol
unchanged_frozen_science.annual_opportunity_gate: retained candidates strictly greater than 50 and at least 20 PIT industries in each of 2018, 2019 and 2020

implementation.reuse_boundary: After CY-047 joint authorization, the R1 runner hash-verifies and dynamically loads the parent runner. Narrow connection adapters verify that the distribution column is entirely structural N/A and that CY-006 optional rights values are only null or zero before presenting economic zero to the unchanged parent eligibility function. The non-filtering Spearman collision summary uses the same average-rank Pearson definition through NumPy so it does not require an unavailable SciPy package. All candidate validation, joining, counting, cooldown and atomic-publication code is otherwise reused.

cy047_joint_authorization.pre_authorization_access: Only this spec, the current runner, the CY-047 manifest and the central registry may be opened before joint authorization. The exact base runner and normalizer may be hashed only after that public envelope passes; no market/corporate-action source may be touched until the inherited source gate also passes.

forbidden: changing the 2-percent yield threshold, cooldown, direction, universe, board set, event timing or annual opportunity gate
any future price, return, payoff, outcome, chart, Stage B, portfolio, parameter search or 2021-plus row
modifying, deleting, overwriting or treating the original V34 Stage-A artifacts as valid economic evidence
next_action: Independently audit and hash-bind the narrow V34R1 runner and CY-047 manifest, then run exactly one outcome-blind Stage-A count audit. If its semantic or opportunity gate fails, close the corrected family without further rescue.
